starter_agents.job: Account research before a first call
starter_agents.try_first: Give it the company and the attendees' roles; get a one-page call plan with 10 ranked discovery questions.
Paste this week's notes and Slack threads; review the draft before it goes anywhere.

starter_agents.source: Grok Bot Outbound Prospecting template (Krista Letz)
starter_agents.try_first: Give it 5 target companies; it returns a sourced review list and sends nothing.
Paste the questionnaire plus your approved security docs; it answers only from them and marks gaps NEEDS REVIEW.
Start with 20-50 real example inputs; it walks you through the build, the evals and a pass-rate report.

starter_agents.source: guide: prospecting-agent-setup.html (built on Grok Bot's official Sales Outbound use case)
starter_agents.try_first: Run the prompt by hand once, then schedule it to stop at the review list.

method: Start here and Advanced are our picks (labeled "Our pick" with a reason). Tools with public GitHub repos show GitHub stars and last commit from the public GitHub API with the date checked, refreshed daily; alternatives are sorted by stars. Public signals only, nothing paid, any featured spot labeled.

releases.name: Build Live Apps in Cursor
releases.summary: Describe an app and a Cursor cloud agent scaffolds it, sets up Postgres if needed, adds Cursor SSO, hosts it, and runs security checks before publish. Available on paid Cursor plans with cloud agents.

releases.name: Crush v0.100.0
releases.summary: Charm's terminal coding agent adds subagents, Sysadmin mode, configurable safe/blocked commands, and GPG/SSH prompts.

releases.name: Mistral Studio (managed agents, workflow builder, connectors)
releases.summary: Mistral's enterprise Studio covers managed agents and apps, workflows, connectors, observability and evals, and deploys in the cloud, a VPC, or on-prem.
